description: This file contains functions and type definitions for resolving Slack users, including parsing user input, listing users via Slack API, scoring matches, and resolving allowlist entries.

methods.name: parseSlackUserInput
methods.description: Parses raw user input string into Slack user identifiers such as ID, name, or email.

methods.name: listSlackUsers
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of Slack users with their details.

methods.name: scoreSlackUser
methods.description: Scores a Slack user match based on criteria like email and name similarity.

methods.name: resolveSlackUserFromMatches
methods.description: Resolves the best Slack user match from a list of candidates based on scoring.
